notes: MediaPipe Face Landmarker 478-point scheme (468 mesh + 10 iris), 0-based. L/R = the subject's side. NO index is verified (verified=false everywhere, even the iris naming): semantics are research candidates until the render-and-detect calibration (tools/calibrate_scheme.py) confirms them. Iris groups are resolved geometrically (lr_groups rule 'geometric'); 'provisional_side' is the contested research column and is never used to assign a side. Points with side 'geometric' outside lr_groups have no known side (resolve from the template embedding). mirror_pairs are [right_index, left_index] and incomplete (mirror_complete=false), except the iris-centre pair [468, 473], whose order carries no side meaning (it only says the two iris centres mirror each other). The iris polylines are named iris_a_* / iris_b_* (letters, not sides) with side 'geometric'; their 'provisional_side' is never used to assign a side. MediaPipe z is ignored.
